acceptanceCriteria: A reviewer in a fresh clone at the bind commit, given the sealed CEM and a handed-off report, can run `make dogfood-check` with `CORVINT_BIN` and observe the verifier set and `outputsAgree`; or DOGFOOD.md step 11 states that verifier agreement is author-only evidence and names what the reviewer verifies instead.
body: Filed on 2026-09-23 from the independent reviewer leg of V1-0146 (PR #102, extracted v0.7.0 build 46 archive, fresh clone at seal head 165e2d7). `make dogfood-check BASE=d18db3d` at ec6cfa48 with CORVINT_BIN set printed `NOTE unbound-commits count=1` then `FAIL dogfood-report-missing` (script/dogfood-check.sh:305) whose fix line names the author's `dogfood-change`. V1-0010 AC3's reviewer-side verifier comparison is therefore NOT_OBSERVED.

completion.reason: Completed 2026-09-24 by PR #133 (merge 5030ba024), through the criterion's second option. Criterion 1: docs/DOGFOOD.md step 11 (:88-93) states that verifier agreement and outputsAgree are author-only evidence and names what the reviewer verifies instead: cem verify, strict cem status and the seal's single rename. This is DCW-V0-017 (docs/specs/daily-change-evidence-workflow-v0.md:101-109). script/dogfood-check.sh:310 prints a review: line naming the cem verify command when HEAD carries the CEM; the reason code and exit 1 are unchanged. The reviewer case is covered in script/dogfood-change_test.sh:860-865, which passes at 6d4873a. A reviewer reproduction at bind 3500aba ran cem verify (exit 0), cem status (ready-for-ci, 4/4) and a single R100 seal diff-tree. Not delivered by design: the first option (reviewer-side outputsAgree), so V1-0010 AC3 stays unobservable. Owner-only: DCW-V0-017 is a new MUST in an accepted spec and awaits owner acceptance; the use-case receipt repin (V1-0216). Sealed at .corvint/changes/2a2f4bb97cb409a4268c2225e084c2d2ebfa2f20.cem.json. Evidence digests: sha256 at 6d4873a of the sealed CEM, DOGFOOD.md, dogfood-check.sh, daily-change-evidence-workflow-v0.md. NOT_RUN: make gate (owner focused-verification policy).

title: dogfood-check: in a fresh clone the check fails `dogfood-report-missing` before any verifier runs, so a reviewer cannot reproduce the override-verifier comparison
